q1_issues.issue: "described" is a speech act with an ordinary NP object, not a finite that-clause attitude, so its subject should be Agent — the progressive test ("is describing" is fine) puts it outside the stative-Experiencer class.
The direct object "the move" gets no role atom on the describe event — Theme is occupied by the predicative complement, so nothing records what was described.

legally_unwarranted / economically_unfounded / politically_unhelpful are fused adverb+adjective compounds emitted with no decomposition atoms, and no compound class in the instruction set licenses that fusion.

q2_gaps: The active object-predicative construction "describe / regard / call X AS P" — only the passive impersonal "X is considered to be P" is covered, so there is no licensed way to attach both the object and the non-asserted predicate to one matrix verb.

A degree/domain -ly adverb modifying an adjective ("legally unwarranted") — Compound concepts covers verb_object, verb_particle, modifier_noun and agent-nominalization, but no adverb+adjective property.
notes: The appositive is handled exactly per spec — the past host wrapper over the Member, powerful and PartOf atoms, with the executive_body decomposition correctly left unwrapped — and the definite "the move" correctly projects out of the seal while the property bundle stays unasserted.
